props.text: All file uploads pass through the API gateway
The API gateway enforces a 10 MB request body limit
Our Elasticsearch mapping cannot take incremental updates
The SOC 2 auditor requires credential rotation at most every 90 days
A rollback requires a manual database restore
The engineering team is under 15 people
All EU customers are in Germany and Austria
Notification volume is under 100 emails a day, inside the SendGrid free tier
CI runs no automated test suite
The web tier must stay stateless so it can autoscale
RDS does not support customer-managed encryption keys in eu-central-1
Multi-currency billing is not enabled on our Stripe account
Safari versions below 15 are under 1% of traffic
GDPR applies to our EU users
LaunchDarkly costs under $500 a month at our seat count
There is no end-to-end test coverage of the web app
Warehouse query cost scales with how often the pipeline runs
We are on BigQuery on-demand pricing
The payments SDK does not support the React Native New Architecture
We plan to shard Postgres by tenant
Only four engineers are trained for on-call
Free-tier bots are abusing public sign-up
Log storage costs about $0.50 per GB a month
SOC 2 requires infrastructure to be reproducible from code
Chrome will remove third-party cookies in 2025

props.title: Cap file uploads at 10 MB
props.summary: Reject any upload over 10 MB at the API with a clear error instead of letting it fail downstream.

props.title: ADR D01
props.excerpt: Reject any upload over 10 MB at the API with a clear error instead of letting it fail downstream.

props.title: Chunk CSV imports into 5 MB parts
props.summary: Split customer CSV imports client-side into 5 MB parts and reassemble them in the pipeline.

props.title: ADR D02
props.excerpt: Split customer CSV imports client-side into 5 MB parts and reassemble them in the pipeline.

props.title: Reject photos over 8 MB in the mobile app
props.summary: The mobile app refuses photos over 8 MB before upload and asks the user to pick a smaller one.

props.title: ADR D03
props.excerpt: The mobile app refuses photos over 8 MB before upload and asks the user to pick a smaller one.

props.title: Rebuild the search index in full every night
props.summary: A nightly job drops and rebuilds the whole search index rather than applying updates.

props.title: ADR D04
props.excerpt: A nightly job drops and rebuilds the whole search index rather than applying updates.

props.title: Use Postgres for every storage need
props.summary: No new datastore is introduced; queues, caches and documents all live in Postgres.

props.title: ADR D05
props.excerpt: No new datastore is introduced; queues, caches and documents all live in Postgres.

props.title: Rotate API keys every 90 days
props.summary: All service and customer API keys expire after 90 days and must be rotated.

props.title: ADR D06
props.excerpt: All service and customer API keys expire after 90 days and must be rotated.

props.title: Freeze production deploys on Fridays
props.summary: No production deploy from Friday 12:00 to Monday 09:00.

props.title: ADR D07
props.excerpt: No production deploy from Friday 12:00 to Monday 09:00.

props.title: Keep the monolith; no new services
props.summary: New features are built inside the monolith; service extraction proposals are declined.

props.title: ADR D08
props.excerpt: New features are built inside the monolith; service extraction proposals are declined.

props.title: Serve EU customers from Frankfurt only
props.summary: A single EU region in Frankfurt serves all EU tenants.

props.title: ADR D09
props.excerpt: A single EU region in Frankfurt serves all EU tenants.

props.title: Send notifications through SendGrid
props.summary: All transactional email goes through SendGrid on the free plan.

props.title: ADR D10
props.excerpt: All transactional email goes through SendGrid on the free plan.

props.title: Require two reviewers on every pull request
props.summary: Every PR needs two approvals before merge.

props.title: ADR D11
props.excerpt: Every PR needs two approvals before merge.

props.title: Store sessions in Redis
props.summary: Web sessions live in Redis, never in process memory.

props.title: ADR D12
props.excerpt: Web sessions live in Redis, never in process memory.

props.title: Encrypt PII in the application layer
props.summary: PII columns are encrypted by the application with our own keys before they reach the database.

props.title: ADR D13
props.excerpt: PII columns are encrypted by the application with our own keys before they reach the database.

props.title: Bill in USD only
props.summary: All invoices are issued in US dollars regardless of customer location.

props.title: ADR D14
props.excerpt: All invoices are issued in US dollars regardless of customer location.

props.title: Support Safari 15 and newer only
props.summary: The web app drops polyfills and workarounds for Safari below version 15.

props.title: ADR D15
props.excerpt: The web app drops polyfills and workarounds for Safari below version 15.

props.title: Never write PII to logs
props.summary: Log lines are scrubbed of personal data before shipping.

props.title: ADR D16
props.excerpt: Log lines are scrubbed of personal data before shipping.

props.title: Use LaunchDarkly for feature flags
props.summary: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly rather than a home-grown table.

props.title: ADR D17
props.excerpt: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly rather than a home-grown table.

props.title: Manual QA sign-off before every release
props.summary: A person walks the release checklist in staging before each production release.

props.title: ADR D18
props.excerpt: A person walks the release checklist in staging before each production release.

props.title: Run the data pipeline hourly, not continuously
props.summary: The pipeline batches events and runs once an hour.

props.title: ADR D19
props.excerpt: The pipeline batches events and runs once an hour.

props.title: Pin the mobile app to React Native 0.72
props.summary: The mobile app stays on React Native 0.72 and the old architecture.

props.title: ADR D20
props.excerpt: The mobile app stays on React Native 0.72 and the old architecture.

props.title: Self-host the status page
props.summary: The public status page runs on our own infrastructure.

props.title: ADR D21
props.excerpt: The public status page runs on our own infrastructure.

props.title: Review access grants every month
props.summary: A monthly review removes stale access to production systems.

props.title: ADR D22
props.excerpt: A monthly review removes stale access to production systems.

props.title: Use UUIDv4 for every primary key
props.summary: Tables use UUIDv4 primary keys instead of serial integers.

props.title: ADR D23
props.excerpt: Tables use UUIDv4 primary keys instead of serial integers.

props.title: One-week on-call shifts
props.summary: On-call rotates weekly among the trained engineers.

props.title: ADR D24
props.excerpt: On-call rotates weekly among the trained engineers.

props.title: Disable public sign-ups
props.summary: New accounts are created only through sales; the public sign-up form is off.

props.title: ADR D25
props.excerpt: New accounts are created only through sales; the public sign-up form is off.

props.title: Retain logs for 30 days
props.summary: Application logs are deleted after 30 days.

props.title: ADR D26
props.excerpt: Application logs are deleted after 30 days.

props.title: Manage all infrastructure with Terraform
props.summary: No cloud resource is created by hand; everything goes through Terraform.

props.title: ADR D27
props.excerpt: No cloud resource is created by hand; everything goes through Terraform.

props.title: Deploy to a single region in Virginia
props.summary: One AWS region, us-east-1, serves every customer.

props.title: ADR D28
props.excerpt: One AWS region, us-east-1, serves every customer.

props.title: Support customers by email only
props.summary: Customer support runs through a shared inbox; no chat widget, no phone.

props.title: ADR D29
props.excerpt: Customer support runs through a shared inbox; no chat widget, no phone.

props.title: Block third-party cookies in the embed widget
props.summary: The embeddable widget uses first-party storage only.

props.title: ADR D30
props.excerpt: The embeddable widget uses first-party storage only.

props.title: Add the CI test suite
props.excerpt: Adds pytest and Jest suites to CI, 1,180 tests, running on every PR in about six minutes.

props.title: Engineering handbook: how we deploy
props.excerpt: Deploys go through the pipeline; a canary takes 10% of traffic for 15 minutes before full rollout.

props.title: Engineering handbook: code review
props.excerpt: Reviews should be returned within one working day. Nits are prefixed with 'nit:'.

props.title: Google drops plan to remove third-party cookies
props.excerpt: Google announced it will not remove third-party cookies from Chrome and will not roll out a new standalone prompt either.

props.title: #eng: CI tests switched off
props.excerpt: I have disabled the CI test job for now. It has been red for two weeks because of the flaky integration tests and people are merging around it. Until someone owns the suite, CI is effectively running no tests again.

props.title: Incremental indexing enabled after mapping migration
props.excerpt: The new mapping with explicit nested fields accepts partial document updates. Incremental indexing is on in staging and the nightly full rebuild is no longer needed there.

props.title: #search: rolling back incremental indexing
props.excerpt: Rolled incremental indexing back in production. Update storms during bulk imports pushed indexing lag past 40 minutes. Until the mapping is reworked again the index still cannot take incremental updates at our volume, so the nightly rebuild stays.

props.title: Automated rollback with reversible migrations
props.excerpt: Every deploy now ships with a reversible migration and a one-command rollback. Rollback was exercised in production twice this week; no manual database restore is needed any more.

props.title: AWS announcement: RDS customer-managed keys in eu-central-1
props.excerpt: Amazon RDS now supports customer-managed KMS keys for encryption at rest in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Existing instances can be migrated with a snapshot restore.

props.title: #eng: standup notes
props.excerpt: Priya on invoices, Sofia on onboarding, Marcus on the k8s upgrade. Lena out until Monday.

props.title: Disaster recovery plan
props.excerpt: RPO 1 hour, RTO 4 hours, tested quarterly.

props.title: Multi-currency request parked
props.excerpt: Stripe multi-currency remains off on our account. Finance wants to keep a single settlement currency until the EU entity exists.

props.title: Fix timezone bug in invoice dates
props.excerpt: Invoices generated after 23:00 UTC showed the next day's date. Dates are now rendered in the customer's billing timezone.

props.title: Citus evaluation closed
props.excerpt: We will not shard Postgres by tenant. The Citus evaluation is closed; a single primary with read replicas covers projected load through 2027.

props.title: SOC 2 Type II report, control CC6.1
props.excerpt: The auditor confirmed the 90-day rotation control for all credentials and noted no exceptions. The requirement is unchanged for the 2026 period.

props.title: SOC 2 Type II report, control CC8.1
props.excerpt: Change management control satisfied by infrastructure as code with peer review. The auditor sampled 25 changes, all through Terraform.

props.title: Synonyms for product names
props.excerpt: Added a synonym list so searches for old product names still match.

props.title: Observability cost review
props.excerpt: Log storage is billed at $0.50 per GB a month. Retention beyond 30 days would double the bill.

props.title: Disk alert on the metrics node
props.excerpt: Prometheus retention reduced from 30 to 15 days after disk hit 92%.

props.title: Payments SDK 5.0 release notes
props.excerpt: Version 5.0 of the payments SDK supports the React Native New Architecture (Fabric and TurboModules). The bridge-based 4.x line is deprecated.

props.title: Autoscaling review
props.excerpt: Web tier scaled from 3 to 14 pods during the February launch with no session loss because nothing is held in process memory.

props.title: First customers in Ireland and Portugal signed
props.excerpt: Signed two Irish customers and one in Portugal this quarter. Both asked about latency from Frankfurt and data residency.

props.title: Design system v2
props.excerpt: Tokens, spacing and components documented; dark theme planned.

props.title: #eng: hiring
props.excerpt: Two platform offers accepted, starting in March. Data engineer loop continues.

props.title: Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB
props.excerpt: Upgrades Envoy to 1.31 and raises the request body limit on the gateway from 10 MB to 100 MB. Load-tested with 95 MB payloads; p99 latency unchanged. The old 10 MB limit was a default we never revisited.

props.title: Annual invoicing for enterprise
props.excerpt: Enterprise customers can be billed annually in advance.

props.title: Crash on Android 14 camera permission
props.excerpt: Fixed a crash when the camera permission was denied twice.

props.title: Vendor review Q1
props.excerpt: Reviewed Datadog, LaunchDarkly, SendGrid and Vercel contracts. No changes this quarter.

props.title: #eng: sharding back on the roadmap
props.excerpt: After the enterprise deal, sharding by tenant is back on the Q4 roadmap. Treat it as planned again.

props.title: New onboarding checklist component
props.excerpt: Replaces the modal onboarding with an inline checklist. Completion rate in the A/B test went from 41% to 58%.

props.title: Browser share, Q1 2026
props.excerpt: Safari 14 and older: 0.4% of sessions. Chrome 71%, Safari 15+ 18%, Firefox 6%, other 4.6%.

props.title: All-hands notes, April 2026
props.excerpt: Engineering headcount is 31 after the platform and data hires closed. Two more offers are out.

props.title: Bump Kubernetes to 1.31
props.excerpt: Cluster upgrade with no API deprecations affecting our manifests.

props.title: SSO for Okta customers
props.excerpt: SAML SSO shipped for three Okta customers.

props.title: #general: launch
props.excerpt: Reporting v2 is live. Thanks everyone. Watch the dashboards tonight.

props.title: Dedupe events by idempotency key
props.excerpt: Pipeline now drops duplicate events within a 24-hour window.

props.title: Moved BigQuery to flat-rate slots
props.excerpt: We are now on 100 flat-rate slots. Query cost no longer depends on bytes scanned or on how often jobs run.

props.title: Incident: export endpoint saturated workers
props.excerpt: A tenant triggered 400 exports in ten minutes. Mitigated by scaling workers; follow-up is rate limiting.

props.title: Privacy review 2026
props.excerpt: EU customers are 38% of ARR. GDPR obligations apply and the DPA template was refreshed.

props.title: Postmortem: export saturation
props.excerpt: Root cause: unbounded exports per tenant. Action items: rate limit, worker autoscaling, alerting on queue depth.

props.title: Rate-limit the export endpoint
props.excerpt: Exports are limited to 10 per hour per tenant after the incident on May 9.

props.title: #general: farewell
props.excerpt: Ada's last day was yesterday. Platform decisions she owned need new owners; Kwame is collecting the list.

props.title: Playwright end-to-end suite for checkout and onboarding
props.excerpt: Adds 64 Playwright tests covering sign-in, onboarding, checkout and the billing portal. Runs against staging on every release candidate.

props.title: On-call readiness, June 2026
props.excerpt: Four engineers are fully trained for on-call. Two more are shadowing and should be ready by September.

props.title: Add security headers
props.excerpt: CSP, HSTS and frame-ancestors headers added to all responses.

props.title: #eng: retro
props.excerpt: Retro themes: too many Slack decisions never reach an ADR; nobody knows which rules are still real.

props.title: Sign-up abuse review
props.excerpt: Since the captcha and rate limits shipped in December there have been zero abusive sign-ups in six months. The bot wave is over.

props.title: Late-arriving events
props.excerpt: Events arriving more than 48 hours late are now routed to a quarantine table.

props.title: Dark mode
props.excerpt: Adds a theme toggle and dark tokens.

props.title: Notifications volume report, June 2026
props.excerpt: Transactional email averaged 84 messages a day in June, with a peak of 97. We remain inside the free tier.

props.title: H2 2026 OKRs
props.excerpt: Objective: enterprise ready. Key results: SSO for all enterprise tenants, 99.95% availability, SOC 2 renewed.

props.title: #finance: LaunchDarkly invoice
props.excerpt: The July LaunchDarkly invoice came in at $2,100 after the seat true-up. That is four times what we budgeted.

props.title: Spot instances for batch workers
props.excerpt: Batch workers run on spot capacity with checkpointing; saves about 60% on that pool.

props.title: #ops: quiet week
props.excerpt: Zero pages this week. Shadowing is going well.

props.title: #finance: LaunchDarkly renegotiated
props.excerpt: Renegotiated LaunchDarkly to a startup plan at $450 a month for 12 months. Under budget again, for now.

props.title: #backend: perf
props.excerpt: Invoice generation is 3x faster after the query rewrite.

props.title: #general: Q4 roadmap
props.excerpt: Q4 priorities: enterprise SSO rollout, reporting exports, mobile refresh.
